title: GenAI Toolbox: Synthetic Health Data Generator
summary: A Streamlit app that generates synthetic 12-lead ECG waveforms via an SSSD-ECG diffusion model and lets users build a RAG pipeline from PDFs to synthesize matching tabular data rows. Its tabular generation path imports SDV's CTGANSynthesizer and SingleTableMetadata directly, with a fallback to the standalone copulas GaussianMultivariate model.
evidence: synthgen_app.py:13-20 imports `from sdv.single_table import CTGANSynthesizer`, `from sdv.metadata import SingleTableMetadata`, and `from copulas.multivariate import GaussianMultivariate`
needs: No explicit .fit()/.sample() call lines were shown in the harvested evidence, so actual invocation of CTGANSynthesizer/GaussianMultivariate beyond import could not be confirmed.
